headword: {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}
gloss: reincarnation; cycle of death and rebirth

definitions.gloss: reincarnation; transmigration of the soul; cycle of death and rebirth
definitions.explanation: The Buddhist and Hindu concept that the soul is reborn into a new body after death, continuing in an endless cycle until enlightenment is achieved.

⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{解脱|げだつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: In Buddhism, the goal is liberation from the cycle of reincarnation.

examples.japanese: {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧にした⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧や⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) composed of ⟦{輪廻|りんね}→輪廻：14486_rinne⟧ (samsara, cycle of rebirth) + {転生|てんしょう} (rebirth, reincarnation). A fundamental concept in Buddhism that has deeply influenced Japanese culture and appears frequently in literature, anime, and manga.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to believe in reincarnation
- {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧: the concept of reincarnation
- {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{解脱|げだつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be liberated from the cycle of rebirth

CULTURAL NOTE:
In modern Japanese popular culture, {転生|てんしょう} (reincarnation) has become a hugely popular genre in light novels and anime, known as {異世界転生|いせかいてんせい} (isekai reincarnation), where characters are reborn in fantasy worlds.
